symptom.note: My mother uses a screen reader. On the refill screen it reads nothing for the refill button and she can't reorder her heart medicine.

root_cause.summary: the refill control was an unnamed, non-focusable div instead of a labelled button, so screen readers announced nothing.

proposed_lessons.text: Never fix #16 by carrying unrelated server changes: the first branch was cut before #15 merged, so Second Opinion saw the privacy fix reverted (PATCH /me/privacy shareHealthData) and /rx/1/refill blank; rebase on main and change only rx.js and styles.css.
